visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair wearing a tan blazer sits at a desk in a studio with a vibrant teal-blue background. She looks off-camera to the left, gesturing with her right hand while speaking. (2) Cut to a young woman in a blue and yellow checkered knit top raising her right hand high in an office setting. She has a wide, enthusiastic smile. Another woman in a grey hoodie sits behind her, working on a laptop. (3) A pink transition screen appears with yellow pineapple patterns and black text stating 'A FEW MOMENTS LATER'. (4) The woman in the checkered top holds a grey laptop, showing the screen to the woman in the blazer. The laptop screen displays a search interface. (5) Close-up shot of the laptop screen showing the Perplexity AI interface. A hand is seen typing queries about '2025 flagship phones' into the search bar, followed by results appearing in a table format. (6) The woman in the checkered top speaks directly to the camera, gesturing frequently. She holds a black bag of 'Donkey' chips and eats one while posing playfully. (7) A close-up of her face as she looks shocked, with white action lines overlaid to emphasize her expression. (8) She leans close to the camera lens, pointing and talking excitedly, then throws her head back in a dramatic laugh while pointing to the laptop.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM begins. A female voice speaks with high energy and professional clarity. (2) A second female voice shouts excitedly, displaying a rising pitch contour and high arousal. (3) A comical 'ding' SFX and transition whoosh sound as the scene shifts. (4) Narration continues with high speech density; several digital UI 'click' and 'pop' SFX are synchronized with screen actions. (5) Audible crunching sound as a chip is eaten. (6) A sharp synthesizer 'shock' hit sound effect plays when the character looks surprised. (7) Rapid-fire dialogue explaining technical benefits, ending with a loud, melodic laugh and a final 'ding' chime.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demo -> Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a partnership between Taiwan Mobile (台灣大哥大) and Perplexity AI. It demonstrates how Perplexity AI's Pro features can significantly enhance workplace efficiency for complex research and file analysis, concluding with a call to action for users to redeem a free one-year subscription.
